'''2013 Worlds Day 3 Reid Smith DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
